receipt, magazining and reconciliation of explosives

facts.site: Yandarra Downs Open Cut and Heavy Workshop
facts.title: loss of containment at MAG-9601 during shift handover

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was first aid or minor property damage.

defences.finding: Control BLAST_GUARDING_AND_CLEARANCE: the guarding, clearance and misfire handling for a blast was in place but did not perform, and the root cause analysis classified this as an absent or failed defence.
Control EXPLOSIVES_RECONCILIATION: the receipt, magazining and reconciliation of explosives was never verified as effective, and the root cause analysis classified this as an organisational factor.

recommendations: Restore the guarding, clearance and misfire handling for a blast on MAG-9601 and record the field verification before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in storing and transporting explosives, specifically receiving, magazining and reconciling explosives. MAG-9601 (explosives magazines) is in service for explosives and detonator storage. The task proceeded during shift handover while the guarding, clearance and misfire handling for a blast was in place but did not perform. The kinetic energy involved is held as rotating equipment, and the recorded presentation was entanglement, impact, crush.
response.summary: On 24 January 2012 an incident occurred on MAG-9601 at Yandarra Downs Open Cut and Heavy Workshop during shift handover, releasing kinetic energy held as rotating equipment.
